title: What's New: Business Central User Experience (2024 release wave 2)

chapters.title: Column Resizing and Page Layout Controls

features.name: Access Keys for Additional Languages
features.description: Extends the access keys feature which allows keyboard shortcuts to navigate actions and features in Business Central to additional languages beyond English, maintaining consistency in key combinations for system actions.

features.name: Modernized Search with Full-Text Index
features.description: Introduces full-text search technology for searching data, lists and filter panes instead of character matching. Matches individual words and delivers faster, more flexible search results based on a full-text index on designated columns.
features.status_evidence_quote: this feature is coming in waves uh it will be delivered starting from October and it will show up for multiple tables in business

features.name: Faster Column Resizing
features.description: Improves the column resizing experience to be faster than before, stored locally in the browser. Still based on personalization when enabled, but now available on pages where personalization was previously not possible, such as copilot prompt dialogue pages.

features.name: Page Layout Control Parameter
features.description: New parameter added to the web client that controls page layout, allowing Business Central to open in specific layouts such as analysis mode, standard list, tiles, or tall tiles via direct links.

features.name: Drag-and-Drop Multiple File Attachments
features.description: Enables users to upload multiple files or entire folders through drag-and-drop functionality in attachments components. Available in incoming documents, document attachments factbox, and email send dialogue.

features.name: New Document Attachments Component
features.description: Modernized attachments component with improved file handling, accessible from multiple places including incoming documents, document attachments, and email dialogue. Supports single or batch file uploads and folder uploads.
caveats: legacy document attachments factbox being obsoleted

features.name: File Upload Action Properties for Developers
features.description: New properties on actions for AL developers to handle multiple file uploads, including allowed file extensions and a trigger to process uploaded files selected by users.
caveats: properties were explained in 2024 release wave 1 developer tools video
